[EN] Clowns and Dolls
[ES] Payasos y muñecas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Put down those jesters and their cursed toys.
[ES] Acaba con esos bufones y sus juguetes malditos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I guess we get the last laugh. Ha!
[ES] Supongo que nosotros reímos al último. ¡Ja!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Play with me! Play with me until you die!
[ES] ¡Juega conmigo! ¡Juega conmigo hasta que mueras!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This is what I call a party!
[ES] ¡A esto le llamo una fiesta!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the cursed jesters and moppet butchers on the fourth floor.
[ES] Destruye a los bufones malditos y a los carniceros de trapo en el cuarto piso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Alssiyah at Gloomhaunt Sentry Post.
[ES] Informa a Alssiyah en el puesto de centinela de Gloomhaunt Sentry Post.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
